hero.intro: Desk-friendly yoga, stretching and expressive movement that release the neck, back and shoulder tension of long screen days. No fitness level or experience needed.

image.alt: Mahima leading a movement session in an office room

shift.heading: For teams that sit too long and carry stress in the body.
shift.body:
This session brings movement back into the work culture. The flow is beginner-friendly, practical and designed
          to release tension without making people feel exposed or out of place.

rhythm.heading: Body first, mind follows.
rhythm.body:
This session keeps movement accessible and grounded. The sequence opens gently, builds energy without pressure,
          and closes with relaxation so people return to work lighter.

steps.title: Mobilise
steps.description: Simple stretching and breath-led warmups release stiffness from desk posture and long meetings.

steps.title: Express
steps.description: Gentle yoga or free movement helps the group move energy without performance pressure.

steps.title: Restore
steps.description: Relaxation and Yoga Nidra settle the body before the team returns to the workday.

prep.heading: Simple to host. We handle the rest.
prep.intro: Here's exactly what your team needs to prepare — and what we bring.

cards.title: Your team provides
items: Open floor space (cleared room or lawn)
Room for mats — we can bring them
Ideally not straight after a heavy meal

cards.title: Good to know
items: Wear clothes you can move in
Beginners fully welcome — no yoga experience
Outdoor option if you have a garden/terrace

pricing.heading: How engagements are priced.
pricing.intro: Every quote is fixed in writing before you commit, and depends on team size, location and format. GST invoice provided.

cards.description: A one-off reset for your team.
Recurring slots that build a habit.

pricing.note: Prices exclude GST and travel for offsite formats. Free rescheduling with 72 hours' notice.

items.question: Do people need to be fit or flexible?
items.answer: No. Everything is beginner-friendly and scalable — desk-yoga to gentle flow. People modify at their own level.

items.question: How many can join?
items.answer: 10–100. Big groups work outdoors or in a hall; we bring extra facilitation for large counts.

items.question: Indoor or outdoor?
items.answer: Either. On-site indoors, your terrace/lawn, or a studio. Outdoor sunrise sessions are a favourite.

items.question: Can it be a recurring slot?
items.answer: Yes — many teams book weekly or fortnightly. Recurring packages are cheaper per session.

items.question: What should the team wear?
items.answer: Comfortable, movement-friendly clothing. No special gear needed.

items.question: What space and equipment do you need?
items.answer: Cleared floor space; we provide mats and any props on request.

items.question: What does it cost?
items.answer: Quoted per session, lower on recurring plans. Book a call for your number.

items.question: How much notice to book?
items.answer: 5–7 days for one-offs; recurring slots are scheduled up front.
